comment: Two Hydralisks with Burrowing and Lurker Aspect researched, one burrowed (U), are told to morph together (L): ExecUnitMorph 0x472a50 morphs the standing one at once and queues the morph behind the burrowed one's Burrowed 117, whose Order_Burrowed 0x43c810 unburrows it first; both become Lurker Eggs.
